notes.title: DEMO UPDATE（1.03）
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679666/817601b90bc476e89f15bd0c1e1854c5dcd7008d.png[/img]

2024/10/19
DEMO UPDATE（1.03）
・Fixed a bug where when selecting a village in MURAYAKI, a backlog would appear with the sub key when trying to select the village again after returning to the base once.
・Fixed the issue where it was difficult to select a village in MURAYAKI (the responsive range was made a little wider)
・ Corrected the default key position for pad operation (the previous key layout will be inherited when loading, so please correct it from the options)
・ Corrected so that Q key advice appears even when using the pad (even if you use the pad, the operation explanation is only displayed on the keyboard)

notes.title: DEMO　UPDATE（1.02）
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679666/fddc38e4a70ac2cebc7335c57a1047c30cb07edc.png[/img]

2024/10/14
DEMO　UPDATE（1.02）
・Fixed a bug where one day would pass if you went shopping at SHOP on a holiday and then went to TALK and returned.
・ Corrected so that the strength of the village changes depending on the difficulty level.
・Corrected the consumption funds for reconstruction to 800 fixed.
・Fixed the backlog being unlocked when returning with the SYSTEM command and changing option settings.
・Added parameter confirmation with subkey when selecting MURAYAKI's village to bake.
(When checking parameters, you will receive advice on missing parameters for casual and normal. There is no advice for hard.)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679666/095eae470df9b0ddadd05fc8ad791e4c5902dc59.png[/img]

2024/10/12
DEMO　UPDATE（1.01）
・Added a message to the save/load screen that says "Press X (cancel) key to return"
・Added a message [Press C (sub) key to return to normal screen] to the bottom right when backlog is displayed.
・Fixed the incorrect image display of the shadow at the end of the opening and flickering.
・Loyalty will now increase a little when you invite someone to a bar and they refuse.
・Corrected the loyalty increase value when displaying “Loyalty has increased!”
